grid = np.array([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in grid_str.strip().split('\n')])

# Find all connected 4-adjacent 3s
from collections import deque

visited = set()
components = []

for i in range(grid.shape[0]):
    for j in range(grid.shape[1]):
        if grid[i, j] == 3 and (i, j) not in visited:
            comp = [(i, j)]
            queue = deque([(i, j)])
            while queue:
                ci, cj = queue.popleft()
                for di, dj in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                    ni, nj = ci + di, cj + dj
                    if 0 <= ni < grid.shape[0] and 0 <= nj < grid.shape[1]:
                        if grid[ni, nj] == 3 and (ni, nj) not in visited:
                            visited.add((ni, nj))
                            comp.append((ni, nj))
                            queue.append((ni, nj))
            visited.add((i, j))
            components.append(comp)

print(f"Number of connected components of 3s: {len(components)}")
for idx, comp in enumerate(components):
    comp_set = set(comp)
    rows = sorted(set(r for r, c in comp))

        corner_cells = [comp_set]  # all are inside
